room_description: An elegant, well-lit study room containing a desk, a large vintage globe, a white sofa, decorative wall shelves, picture frames, and an attached bathroom.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the elegant study room.
Inspects the cushions on the white sofa.
Finds and collects a metal pin/handle resting on a book on the desk.
Examines the decorative shelving unit on the wall.
Uses the metal pin to unlock the vintage globe.
Enters the attached bathroom and attaches the handle to a blank drawer.
Opens the bathroom drawer and collects a red towel and a spray bottle.
Sprays cleaning fluid on the dirty bathroom mirror and wipes it with the towel.
Reveals the hidden code '7649' written in red on the mirror.
Enters the mirrored code into the keypad on the dark wooden cabinet.

solution_steps: Locate the metal pin on the desk.
Insert it into the slot on the vintage globe to pop it open.
Attach the handle to the bathroom drawer to access the cleaning supplies.
Spray the clouded mirror with the bottle.
Wipe the mirror clean with the red towel to reveal the hidden 4-digit code.
Take the code '7649' found on the bathroom mirror.
Type it into the electronic keypad on the main room's dark cabinet.

final_action: Retrieves the blue keycard from the opened cabinet and swipes it to unlock the exit door.
